tasks.short: Provide environmental, health or safety programme information

steps.what: Clarify the actual request for environmental, public-health or workplace-safety assistance
inputs: actual government, employer or public request
requester's actual context and question
outputs: confirmed information need and unresolved context

steps.what: Find and verify the current published programme information relevant to the request
inputs: confirmed information need and unresolved context
current approved public guidance and programme records
outputs: checked source passages and questions requiring specialist referral

steps.what: Prepare a source-linked written explanation and exact requester destination
inputs: checked source passages and questions requiring specialist referral
confirmed information need and unresolved context
verified requester destination
outputs: complete draft explanation with source links and exact recipient

loop.purpose: Propose plain wording for a bounded public-information answer
loop.input: actual request and checked current approved source passages
loop.output: draft explanation with passage links, explicit limits and referral questions
loop.check: Technician checks meaning, conditions, omissions and unsupported advice against each source; recipient checked separately
loop.stop: Site-specific judgement, emergency, missing source or conflicting guidance goes to the responsible specialist
loop.why_not_simpler: Exact standard answers use templates; variable wording of source-supported explanations needs a bounded language step

steps.what: Approve the completed explanation, sources, limitations and exact requester recipient
inputs: complete draft explanation with source links and exact recipient
checked source passages and questions requiring specialist referral
outputs: approved final explanation and requester recipient

steps.what: Explain the checked information and provide live programme assistance within the technician's authority
inputs: approved final explanation and requester recipient
actual requester follow-up questions
outputs: actual explanation and unresolved assistance needs

steps.what: Send the exact approved written explanation to the approved requester destination
inputs: approved final explanation and requester recipient
outputs: sent approved information reply

steps.what: Save the approved explanation in the existing information-request record
inputs: approved final explanation and requester recipient
outputs: saved approved information reply

tasks.design: Configure approved-source retrieval in {DOCS}, using standard replies first and a bounded wording proposal for variable information requests. The technician checks the completed reply and provides live assistance before the separate approved send in {EMAIL}; unresolved technical judgements go to the responsible specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right current guidance and expressing it for a particular question can take time around actual assistance.
tasks.enabler_now: Maintained source search and source-linked draft wording can reuse approved public information.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous circumstances and questions beyond published guidance require a person or specialist referral.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises when a request needs practical clarification rather than a confident generic answer.

ambition.what: Prepare understandable, source-supported programme information for another requester group.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–4 for source-owner review and requester-data permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a maintained approved-source library can support retrieval and bounded explanation drafts, with human review before a reply is sent.

assumptions: All shares are provisional scenarios, not measured assistance baselines.
Actual request clarification is counted in s1; the source owner maintains current approved guidance, with ongoing upkeep charged below.
Native search and standard reply templates first. No tool supplies legal, medical or site-specific safety decisions from missing context.
s5 does not silently alter the written payload. Any change after s4 requires renewed approval before s6.
The send is retained with no saving; the same-folder save is approximately zero today and receives no saving.
research_questions: Which request types can be answered wholly from current approved sources?

already_counted.description: Check completed reply meaning, limits and exact recipient

incremental.description: Maintain source versions and standard replies and sample draft errors

approvals.approved_version: approved exact explanation, sources and recipient; changes return to s4
approved final information reply from s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 15 source-retrieval hours +10 draft-wording hours =25. Three upkeep hours give central net 22%; five extra hours correcting context and source mismatches gives high 17%. Low zero if existing standard replies already cover the work or review absorbs the drafting reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain environmental, chemical and exposure files

steps.what: Maintain hazardous waste databases, chemical usage data, personnel exposure information or equipment diagrams by identifying actual authorised updates
inputs: actual authorised waste, chemical-use, exposure or equipment-location updates
existing file register and access restrictions
outputs: verified update scope and source provenance

steps.what: Prepare file updates by mapping existing structured source fields to the correct record or diagram reference
inputs: verified update scope and source provenance
existing structured source identifiers, quantities, units, dates and revision references
approved file field definitions
outputs: complete proposed file update with source-linked fields

steps.what: Check proposed updates for valid identifiers, units, dates, revision references and permitted access
inputs: complete proposed file update with source-linked fields
approved file field definitions and access rules
outputs: checked update fields and flagged inconsistencies

steps.what: Resolve missing or ambiguous source details with the actual source owners and capture corrections
inputs: checked update fields and flagged inconsistencies
source owners' actual clarifications
outputs: corrected complete final file update with unresolved gaps explicit

steps.what: Approve the exact completed file update against source facts and access restrictions
inputs: corrected complete final file update with unresolved gaps explicit
verified update scope and source provenance
outputs: approved final environmental file update

steps.what: Commit the approved update to the designated environmental record
inputs: approved final environmental file update
outputs: saved environmental record revision with source references

tasks.design: Use native import and validation in the environmental records system {OPS_SYSTEM}, adding a deterministic mapping only where approved structured sources cannot import directly. Keep source documents and diagram revision links in {DOCS}; the technician resolves ambiguity before approving each record revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field mapping and repeated validity checks can add effort to maintaining environmental files.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured source imports and native validation can reuse actual identifiers and values with provenance.
tasks.still_hard: Exposure meaning, changed equipment location and ambiguous source corrections need the responsible people.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises when a valid-looking field belongs to the wrong person, material or location.

ambition.what: Review pending source updates and unresolved file discrepancies more frequently.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for sensitive exposure-data access and source-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: records systems can import structured fields, validate identifiers and retain versioned source references with restricted access.

assumptions: Provisional shares and savings, not measured current filing baselines.
Actual source updates already exist with identifiers and units from authorised operations or laboratory staff. New field measurement or exposure-data collection must be separately counted if absent.
For equipment diagrams, the source is an actual authorised revised drawing or location record; the tool links its revision rather than inventing geometry.
s4 retains actual clarification and correction authoring; no model infers sensitive exposure information.

Native import and validation first. Each target record is approved separately in real use; the graph describes one revision, not an ungated multi-record write. The same-system commit receives no saving.
research_questions: Which actual fields can import with stable source identifiers?

already_counted.description: Check exact completed file update and access restrictions

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings, field definitions and restricted-access checks

approvals.approved_version: approved exact environmental record revision; changes return to s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 17.5 field-mapping hours +8 fixed-validation hours =25.5. Upkeep 2.5 gives central net 23%; five additional hours resolving source inconsistencies gives high 18%. Low zero if native import already covers the work or source records are unsuitable.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop or implement environmental monitoring programmes

steps.what: Define the actual pollution or radiation monitoring objectives and applicable approved requirements
inputs: actual monitoring purpose and site conditions
current specialist-approved requirements and methods
outputs: checked monitoring goals and constraints

steps.what: Review actual historical monitoring results, equipment availability and coverage gaps
inputs: existing actual monitoring results with sites, times, methods and units
actual equipment and calibration records
outputs: checked monitoring history and resource gaps

steps.what: Develop the proposed sampling or monitoring programme with the supervising specialist
inputs: checked monitoring goals and constraints
checked monitoring history and resource gaps
supervising specialist's actual method and coverage decisions
outputs: human-defined monitoring methods, locations and cadence

steps.what: Prepare the monitoring schedule and field worksheets from the actual approved locations and cadence
inputs: human-defined monitoring methods, locations and cadence
actual field access and equipment availability
outputs: complete monitoring schedule and field worksheets

steps.what: Implement the authorised monitoring programme in the field and handle actual deployment constraints
inputs: complete monitoring schedule and field worksheets
actual specialist authorisation for field work
actual monitoring equipment and site access
outputs: actual implemented monitoring activities and field deviations

steps.what: Record actual implementation, equipment identifiers and deviations from the planned programme
inputs: actual implemented monitoring activities and field deviations
outputs: complete actual monitoring implementation record

steps.what: Approve the completed implementation record against actual field activity
inputs: complete actual monitoring implementation record
outputs: approved final actual implementation record

steps.what: Save the approved actual monitoring implementation record
inputs: approved final actual implementation record
outputs: saved actual monitoring implementation record

tasks.design: Configure historical monitoring views and recurring schedule templates in the environmental monitoring system {OPS_SYSTEM}, with date views in {CALENDAR}. The technician and specialist determine the programme, and the technician implements it using monitoring equipment {OTHER}; actual implementation is recorded after field work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated history review and schedule/worksheet setup can surround programme design and field implementation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native monitoring views and cadence templates can reuse checked historical data and human-defined programme fields.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting representative monitoring methods and handling real field constraints require technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician notices when the planned method cannot answer the site question or cannot be implemented as assumed.

ambition.what: Review programme coverage when actual monitoring history reveals a gap.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for field permissions, specialist review and staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: monitoring systems can display historical coverage and generate recurring schedules and worksheets from approved methods and locations.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional, not measured programme-development baselines.
Existing history has source metadata; absent measurements or calibration work is not invented or free.
The specialist controls actual method approval and field authorisation. s3 counts technician planning and captures actual chosen methods; no automated scientific design is assumed.
Schedules are prospective. Actual implementation and deviations are produced in s5 and captured in s6; planned events are not evidence of completion.
Native recurring schedules first. No saving in field implementation, actual outcome capture or same-system save.
Sampling notifications or external reports are separate actions if locally required; no such send or saving is silently claimed.
research_questions: Which history review and schedule setup remains repetitive after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check actual implementation record against field activity

incremental.description: Maintain monitoring views and approved cadence/worksheet templates

approvals.approved_version: approved final actual implementation record; edits return to s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 7.5 history-review hours +6 schedule-preparation hours =13.5. Upkeep 1.5 gives central net 12%; four extra hours resolving site access and cadence changes gives high 8%. Low zero with current native coverage.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor emission control device operation and compliance

steps.what: Review actual emission-control device readings, operating trends and recorded status against approved limits
inputs: actual device telemetry with timestamps, device identifiers and quality flags
current approved operating and compliance limits
outputs: checked device trends and flagged readings requiring inspection

steps.what: Inspect actual emission control devices and verify apparent operating abnormalities
inputs: checked device trends and flagged readings requiring inspection
actual device and site conditions
outputs: actual device observations and verified or unresolved abnormalities

steps.what: Evaluate operation and compliance evidence and identify issues needing specialist action
inputs: actual device observations and verified or unresolved abnormalities
checked device trends and flagged readings requiring inspection
current approved operating and compliance limits
outputs: human-authored operating assessment and unresolved compliance issues

steps.what: Capture actual observations and assessment in the monitoring record with linked instrument values
inputs: human-authored operating assessment and unresolved compliance issues
actual device observations and verified or unresolved abnormalities
actual timestamped device readings
outputs: complete actual device monitoring record draft

steps.what: Discuss actual abnormalities and unresolved issues with the responsible operating or environmental specialist
inputs: human-authored operating assessment and unresolved compliance issues
actual specialist questions and responses
outputs: actual specialist direction and unresolved follow-up

steps.what: Capture actual specialist direction and outstanding issues in the completed monitoring record
inputs: complete actual device monitoring record draft
actual specialist direction and unresolved follow-up
outputs: complete final actual device monitoring record

steps.what: Approve the completed final monitoring record after checking actual observations and specialist direction
inputs: complete final actual device monitoring record
outputs: approved final actual device monitoring record

steps.what: Save the approved actual device monitoring record
inputs: approved final actual device monitoring record
outputs: saved actual emission-device monitoring record

tasks.design: Configure native emission-device trend and exception views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, linking actual readings to the monitoring form. The technician inspects the physical emission control equipment {OTHER}, evaluates evidence and captures actual observations; the system does not adjust a device or declare compliance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated trend inspection and copying instrument fields can add effort around actual equipment monitoring.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing telemetry and approved threshold views can focus inspection and reuse timestamped device fields.
tasks.still_hard: Sensor faults, unexplained trends and whether evidence establishes proper operation require technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can recognise that a nominally acceptable reading may be unreliable or inconsistent with the actual equipment.

ambition.what: Inspect current operating exceptions more frequently using actual device data.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for telemetry access, approved limits and operator consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: environmental monitoring systems can display actual device trends, apply configured threshold views and reuse instrument fields in records.

assumptions: All shares and savings are provisional, not measured equipment-monitoring baselines or a regulatory opinion.
Actual telemetry already exists with quality flags and timestamps; installing missing sensors or collecting absent readings must be separately counted.
The competent owner supplies current operating and compliance limits. A threshold flag is evidence for inspection, not a compliance decision.
s4 retains actual observation and assessment entry; only repeated instrument fields and form setup change. s6 captures later actual specialist direction and s6b checks the complete final version.
Native trend/form configuration first. No automatic control changes, unrepresented alerts or external regulator sends are claimed. Same-system save has no saving.
unknowns: Telemetry reliability and existing trend views
research_questions: Which repeated trend and instrument-field work remains after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check completed actual monitoring record and specialist direction

incremental.description: Maintain approved trend thresholds and instrument-field mappings

approvals.approved_version: approved final actual device monitoring record; edits return to s6b

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 15 trend-review hours +3 repeated-field hours =18. Two upkeep hours give central net 16%; four extra hours resolving unreliable telemetry gives high 12%. Low zero if native features are already used or readings are unsuitable.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: environmental scientist or engineer: approve methods and difficult interpretations
source owners: provide actual traceable environmental records
role.ambitious_version: An environmental technician who prepares information and records faster while retaining direct field monitoring, source checks and specialist escalation.

job.title: Environmental Science and Protection Technicians, Including Health
